text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the Kikuka Sho paddock, Mejiro Ardan suddenly feels an immense pressure she's never experienced before—and its source is the smiling Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan is thankful for her first-ever opportunity to face such strong competition. With Yaeno Muteki feeling the same way, the pair prepare for a race they know will test their talent.
